notes.scope: Hugging Face speech-model pins only. LLM backends (e.g. a local Ollama server) are separate: the receiving agent must inspect available models, licenses and sizes for the real hardware and pull them only after explicit authorization.
notes.downloads: Nothing is downloaded automatically. Fetching requires the explicit --accept-download flag on 'python -m dubkit models fetch' or 'run'.
notes.redistribution: Weights live in the recipient's local Hugging Face cache. Do not re-upload, bundle or ship them with any output package.
notes.verified_source: Pinned identifiers and file metadata from the public Hugging Face API. No model weights are included in this source package.

asr.license_note: The model card at this revision declares no license field. Check the upstream OpenAI Whisper model and its license/terms (https://github.com/openai/whisper) before any redistribution or commercial use; do not assume MIT.

tts.license_note: Declared as apache-2.0 on the model card.
tts.usage_note: Base checkpoint ships no built-in voices: voice cloning requires the user's own explicit reference audio (--ref-audio with --ref-text-file).

custom_tts.license_note: Declared as apache-2.0 on the model card.
custom_tts.usage_note: Ships pretrained custom voices, so the default flow works without any private reference audio.
